title: Pro vs Con: 7 AI Models
sources: OpenAI DevDay, Oct 2025: ChatGPT has about 800 million weekly users; OpenAI notes 'ChatGPT can make mistakes'
Google blog, Feb 2024: 'Gemini image generation got it wrong' - image generation of people paused
Anthropic: Claude models offer 200K-token context and are widely used for coding; Claude does not generate images
Open Source Initiative: Meta's Llama license is not an open source license (usage restrictions)

DeepSeek-V3 technical report (Dec 2024): ~$5.6M reported final training-run cost; R1 (Jan 2025) comparable to top reasoning models; Italy's Garante blocked the app (Jan 2025); Australia, Taiwan, South Korea restricted it on government devices; documented censorship of topics sensitive to the Chinese government
xAI / X: Grok uses real-time X posts; July 2025 antisemitic replies, xAI apologized
Mistral AI (France): open-weight models under Apache 2.0, Le Chat assistant; funding far below US leaders (e.g. ~EUR 1.7B round, Sept 2025)

lines.text: Seven AI models. Seven reasons to love them.
And seven reasons to worry. Let's fight!
Number one, ChatGPT! Around eight hundred million people use it every week.
Sure. But the best stuff costs money, and it can still make things up.
lines.caps: THE BEST STUFF *COSTS | IT CAN *MAKE | THINGS *UP

lines.text: Number two, Gemini. It lives right inside Gmail, Docs and Search.
The same Gemini that got history so wrong, Google paused its image tool?
Okay. Number three, Claude. Coders love it, and it reads huge documents.
Cool. Now ask it for a picture. It can't make images.
Number four, Meta's Llama. Free to download and run yourself!
lines.caps: NUMBER FOUR *LLAMA | *FREE TO DOWNLOAD | RUN IT *YOURSELF

lines.text: Free, with strings attached. Its license has limits, so it's not truly open source.
Number five, DeepSeek. It rivaled top models for a fraction of the reported cost.
lines.caps: NUMBER FIVE *DEEPSEEK | *RIVALED THE TOP | A *FRACTION | OF THE *COST

lines.text: And it dodges sensitive topics. Some governments banned it on official devices.
Number six, Grok. It reads live posts from X.
Live posts? That's partly how it ended up posting offensive replies in twenty twenty-five.
Number seven, Mistral, from France. Fast, and many of its models are open.
On way less money than the American giants.
You decide. Fight it out in the comments!
